regime_context: The detector shows a very narrow, one-narrative tape: only Coal and Banks clear the eligibility gate (2 of 22 themes), with Coal leading Banks by a modest margin. Crucially, the absolute-trend gate did NOT help on this market's history (gate_helps=false, mean-reverting tape), so trend discipline here is experimental and the detector offers no validated forward edge — I am defaulting to low conviction and very few checkable leans.
emerging_watch: Watching for a CONFIRMED leadership handoff from Coal to Banks: I would retire the 'Coal dominant' read only if Banks close the score margin (currently 0.135) AND Coal's durability_bar drops below Banks' while Coal loses eligibility — otherwise Coal remains the one-narrative leader and Banks is merely the strongest eligible alternative.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the strongest ELIGIBLE alternative to the crowded Coal leader: they carry the second-highest score, the best durability bar in the ranks (0.56, the only high-quality trend tag among the eligible), and they are gated in while almost everything else is gated out. The rotation structure (one_narrative, narrow breadth) means leadership is concentrated, and Banks are the only clean, scorable challenger with a trend-like health reading. This is a relative-preferences lean, not a return forecast.
evidence: crowding_z=1.9 flags size-down caution only, not a fade
theses.dissent: Banks are crowded (crowding_z 1.9), and on a mean-reverting tape the second-ranked theme can give back gains as fast as it made them — the absolute-trend gate has no drawdown-cutting history here, so the 'eligible' edge is unproven.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS lags the CSI 300 benchmark by 5% or more before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the dominant one-narrative leader (score 1.135, only theme with one_narrative=true among the eligible) and carries a positive 10-day return (r10=0.0359), but it is crowded, has breadth=0.0, and its hurst_tag is 'mean-revert' — exactly the regime where the trend gate failed historically. I lean with the dominant theme only because fading the leader is the documented failure mode, not because the detector predicts it; crowding is a size-down caution.
theses.dissent: Coal is a mean-reverting narrative with zero breadth and heavy crowding — on a tape where the trend gate whipsaws, leadership can decay quickly and the one-narrative concentration implies no diversification support.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS gives back its 10-day gain and lags the CSI 300 benchmark by 5% or more before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
